summary: Iteration 4 — verified the scrape.do Google Search integration end-to-end for the Welspun tenant. Triggered a fresh POST /api/tenants/0d66bfb6-9534-481f-a241-d510886d4085/run?collector=search_dork as super admin: endpoint returned 200 in <1s, background run completed in 30.3s, monitoring-health row 'Search/Dorking' = healthy, items_found=92, new_findings=21. GET /api/findings?module=social now returns 114 real, brand-relevant Welspun findings across 12 platforms (Scribd 14, Reddit 12, Pinterest 12, Twitter 11, LinkedIn 10, Telegram 9, Threads 7, Facebook 7, YouTube 6, X 6, Instagram 3, TikTok 3) with BOTH profile/account URLs (linkedin.com/company/welspun-specialty-solutions-limited, facebook.com/p/Welspun-Tubular-..., t.me/s/...) and post URLs (instagram.com/p/DUQQUuLEsEX, twitter.com/WelspunWorld/status/..., youtube.com/watch?v=..., tiktok.com/@x/video/..., reddit.com/r/.../comments/...): 31 post-style + 17 profile-style URLs. 100% of returned URLs resolve to the expected social hosts and 100% contain the brand token. Frontend: tenant switcher -> Welspun, Social Media page renders '1-25 of 114' with working next/prev pagination, expanded platform filter (14 options) narrows Instagram to 9 rows (all instagram.com), finding drawer opens with Evidence/Verification/Entities tabs populated (username, snippet, impersonation confidence 45%, classification SUSPICIOUS). CSV export returns social rows. Regressions all pass: Stripe Payments still exactly 69 social findings with non-overlapping pagination, all 4 role logins OK, /api/findings/report.pdf returns 200 %PDF, overlapping Run Now returns 'A scan is already running' (200, no 500/timeout). SCRAPE_DO_KEY is read from backend/.env via os.environ and is NOT present anywhere in backend source. Backend 17/17 pytest tests pass.

minor.issue: evidence.engine is hardcoded to 'duckduckgo' (collectors.py ~line 848) even when the result came from scrape.do/Google. The finding drawer's Evidence tab therefore displays 'Engine: duckduckgo' for scrape.do results — misleading provenance for analysts/audits. Should be 'scrape.do (google)' when the scrape.do path is used.

No duplicate guard: two distinct tenants both named 'Welspun' exist (0d66bfb6... with 114 social findings, a801f925... with 0). GET /api/tenants returns both and the tenant switcher shows two identical 'Welspun' entries, so a user can land on the empty one and conclude 'no data' again — exactly the original complaint. Recommend dedupe by name/primary_domain or delete the stale a801f925-7693-4aa1-b195-cdee438d4a8d tenant.

Platform values are stored case-sensitively and the filter is an exact match, so ?platform=instagram returns 0 while ?platform=Instagram returns 9. Case-insensitive matching would be safer for API consumers.

Brand token may match only in the snippet, letting off-target items through, e.g. Telegram finding 'Walk-In Interview Jobs & Careers' (https://t.me/s/Walk_in_Interview) is surfaced as a Welspun social account. Low volume but noticeable noise.

ui_bugs.issue: Post-type findings are rendered in the 'ACCOUNT NAME' column with the post caption as the account name and the URL shortcode as the handle (e.g. '@DUQQUuLEsEX', '@DcS-UzGChUW', '@WELSPUN-CORP-LTD-REPORT-1'). Confusing for analysts — posts should show the owning account/handle or be visually distinguished from accounts.

Filter list contains both 'X' and 'Twitter' as separate platforms even though both map to the same brand/host family (results split 6/11 across them), and 'Pastebin' which is not part of the social DORK_TARGETS set (always yields 0). Merge X/Twitter and drop dead options.

Console errors on drawer open: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible' and 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby`'. Accessibility gap only, no functional impact.

issues: Almost every Instagram/Twitter post from what is clearly the official Welspun corporate account is labelled Type='Impersonation' with 'Suspicious 48%'. Verification tab reveals the cause: 'Username similarity: Unknown (no official handle configured)'. Official handles are not seeded for the Welspun tenant, so genuine brand content is scored as suspicious — high false-positive rate that undermines trust in the new data. Recommend seeding official handles or defaulting posts on official-domain-linked accounts to LEGITIMATE.
Layout/contrast/spacing otherwise clean; sidebar, filter bar and table alignment look correct at 1920x1080.

action_items: Set evidence.engine (and any UI provenance label) to 'scrape.do (google)' when the scrape.do path is used instead of the hardcoded 'duckduckgo'.
Remove/merge the duplicate empty 'Welspun' tenant (a801f925-7693-4aa1-b195-cdee438d4a8d) and add a duplicate-name/domain guard on POST /api/tenants so the user cannot land on an empty duplicate.
Seed official social handles for tenants (or relax scoring) so official brand posts are not classified as Impersonation/Suspicious.
Make the /api/findings platform filter case-insensitive; merge X/Twitter and drop 'Pastebin' from SocialMedia platformOptions.
Require the brand token in title/URL/handle (not snippet alone) to cut noise like t.me/s/Walk_in_Interview.
Add DialogTitle/aria-describedby to the finding drawer sheet to clear a11y console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: collectors.py is 1238 lines and server.py ~979 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline; split collectors into per-source modules.

collect_search_dork runs blocking httpx.get/time.sleep inside an async-served background task; it works via the background runner but should use httpx.AsyncClient or a thread executor to avoid blocking the event loop as concurrency grows.

_scrape_do_search has no retry/backoff and no per-call budget accounting for a paid API; a transient 429/5xx silently degrades a whole platform (caught by the broad except and only recorded in `error`).
SCRAPE_DO_KEY correctly read via os.environ with no source hardcoding — verified programmatically in test_scrape_do_key_in_env_not_source.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (pagination, platform filter, drawer, CSV, tenant switch)

seed_data_creation: None created. One fresh search_dork run executed against existing Welspun tenant 0d66bfb6-9534-481f-a241-d510886d4085 (added 21 new findings; total social 114). Only 1 scrape.do run consumed as instructed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Welspun tenant id 0d66bfb6-9534-481f-a241-d510886d4085 (the OTHER Welspun, a801f925-..., is empty — pick by max social findings, as the fixture in test_welspun_scrapedo.py does). PDF route is /api/findings/report.pdf (NOT /api/tenants/{id}/report.pdf); CSV is /api/findings/export. Platform filter is case-sensitive ('Instagram'). Run pytest with '-n 0' to override the xdist args in pytest.ini. Deselect '-k "not trigger_run"' to avoid spending paid scrape.do credits on re-runs.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (no social data) was caused by free search backends (ddgs/DuckDuckGo/Bing) serving blocked or junk responses to this datacenter IP, so the strict brand-relevance filter discarded everything and the Search/Dorking collector reported 'degraded' with 0 items. The scrape.do Google plugin proxies searches through residential IPs and returns clean organic_results JSON; with SCRAPE_DO_KEY set, collect_search_dork now prefers it and the 10s inter-platform pacing is skipped, so a full 13-platform sweep finishes in ~30s and yields 90+ brand-relevant findings. Verified independently in this iteration. Residual issues are cosmetic/data-quality (hardcoded engine label, duplicate tenant, impersonation false positives), not collection failures.
